name: TAG-EQA
description: TAG-EQA is a benchmark for embodied question answering that addresses question ambiguity through spatial and temporal grounding. It includes a new dataset designed for ambiguous grounded episodic memory QA, incorporating situated spatial reasoning, temporal conditions, and diverse visual features, with an evaluation procedure for grounded natural language answers.
reputation: A recent specialized benchmark that is still early in adoption, primarily used by researchers working on embodied QA, grounding, and episodic memory.
notes: Focuses on ambiguity resolution in embodied QA; introduces new dataset and evaluation procedure.
